research.title: Give yourself room to be human
research.summary: Welcome to this week’s edition of the Threat Source newsletter. Fall is officially here in Maryland, and I can’t be more relieved. I flourish in 50 degree weather, where it feels natural to burrow under blankets, knit sweaters, and listen to an audiobook..

research.title: What Security Metrics Actually Matter?
research.summary: Cybersecurity has no shortage of metrics. Organizations track vulnerabilities discovered, tickets created, patches applied, remediation SLAs, and countless other measures of security activity. These metrics help teams manage workloads and identify.

research.title: One Port to Root: Weaponizing Check Point Management CVE-2026-93616

research.title: CVE-2026-76504 | Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager API Authentication Bypass Vulnerability | Reversed by Horizon3
